classification: H2 — a source-derived localized cubic-score square bound is proved, but its natural-cutoff majorant does not reach the discrepancy threshold

decision_gate.first_missing_estimate: a source-matched centered endpoint partial-sum bound for g_k=(H^3)_kk on the two length-M windows, strong enough that E|Y_L|+E|Y_R|=o(d)
decision_gate.same_section: if endpoint discrepancy=o(1), Markov gives an intersection of D2-admissible density >=1/4, energy-good density >=7/8, and score-good density 1-o(1); this applies only to the direct first-strike consumer
decision_gate.theorem_status: strict >79%, m3=2, conditioned Cayley energy <0.105, signed fifth/sixth gate, prime-to-Weil, zero-side, and determinant compatibility remain OPEN

direct_route.absolute_majorant: E_u|Y_L|+E_v|Y_R|=O(K_T*(M+NL)); normalized bound O(K_T*M/d) when M>>NL
direct_route.natural_scale: K_T*M/d=O((1+sqrt(N)/L)*exp(-sqrt(L)/2)); its leading envelope is exp(L/2-sqrt(L))/L and diverges
direct_route.signed_mean_warning: control of a signed mean does not bound the mean absolute partial sum

exact_identities.diagonal_score: g_k=a_k^3+sum_{j!=k}(2*a_k+a_j)W_kj^2+sum_{j,l pairwise distinct from k and each other}W_kj*W_jl*W_lk; a=s0+beta; W_ij=(A_i-A_j)/(pi*(j-i))
exact_identities.global_score: tau_d(H^3)-tau_d'(A^3)=[sum_{k in Q}(g_k-m_T)]/d' + [2Tr(A B B*)+Tr(D B* B)]/d', where g_k=(H^3)_kk, m_T=Tr(H^3)/d, A=PHP, B=PHQ, D=QHQ

localized_score_bound.conclusion: This local estimate is rigorous but does not certify the required little-o condition; divergence of the majorant is not a lower bound or a source counterexample.
localized_score_bound.endpoint_q_mass: uniformly for either endpoint window J of length M, sum_J q_k=O(M+NL), by local large sieve and dyadic control of sum_{j in I0} A_j^2*sum_{k in J}(j-k)^(-2)
localized_score_bound.global_second_trace: Tr(H^2)=O(d+NL)=O(d), from the same source large sieve on I0 and summability of |j-k|^-2
localized_score_bound.mean_bound: |m_T|<=K_T*Tr(H^2)/d=O(K_T); no value or sign is assigned
localized_score_bound.natural_cutoff_ratio: the proved upper majorant divided by d^2/M is O((K_T^4+K_T^2)*(M/d)^2)=O((1+N^2/L^4+N/L^2)*exp(-sqrt(L))); its leading displayed envelope is exp(2L-3sqrt(L))/L^4 and diverges
localized_score_bound.uniform_S6_relation: uniform tau_d(|H|^6)=O(1) implies the endpoint S2 condition; the endpoint-only condition is strictly weaker (an abstract interior diagonal spike violates global S6 while preserving endpoint S2)

prime_expansion.boundary_scope: No infinite-lattice replacement or finite-boundary uniform transfer is used.
prime_expansion.cycles: ordered j,l in I0, pairwise distinct with k and each other; product (A_k-A_j)(A_j-A_l)(A_l-A_k)/(pi^3*(j-k)*(l-j)*(k-l))
prime_expansion.diagonal: a_k^3=s0^3+3*s0^2*beta_k+3*s0*beta_k^2+beta_k^3; beta_k^3 is the complete finite signed triple sum over P(N)^3 and sigma^3
prime_expansion.resonance: for three prime powers, zero carrier requires a 2-vs-1 equality; unique factorization forces same prime base and exponents add (e.g. 2*4=8). All-plus/all-minus cannot close. Nonzero and near aliases are retained.
prime_expansion.sampling: for each expanded term, after fixing other indices, the varying endpoint index has exact frequency omega equal to the signed sum of alpha factors attached to that index; sum_{k=k0}^{k0+u-1} exp(2*pi*i*k*omega) has magnitude u if omega is integer and otherwise <=min(u,1/|sin(pi*omega)|). Carrier exp(i*T*Omega) remains separate.

scope: Finite rational checks verify algebra only. The local large-sieve consequences use their inherited analytic hypotheses. No source-valid cubic discrepancy estimate or >79 theorem is claimed.

source.fields: A_k=sum_n Im(z_n exp(2*pi*i*k*alpha_n)); beta_k=sum_n 2*(1-alpha_n) Re(z_n exp(2*pi*i*k*alpha_n))
source.large_sieve: uniform translated interval J of integer length h: sum_J A_k^2=O(h+NL), sum_J beta_k^2=O(h+NL), with all prime powers and actual carrier phases
source.operator: ||H||op<=K_T=|s0|+4*S, S=sum_{n in P(N)}|c_n|=O(sqrt(N)/L); s0->1 and a_phi->1
source.pool: P(N)={p^v:p prime,v>=1,p^v<=N}; all proper powers retained
source.section: I0=[b,b+d-1]; I_uv=[b+u,b+d-1-v], 0<=u,v<=M; Q=QL union QR, d'=d-u-v>=d-2M
